A '''battle''' in the [[Orocco system/Legends|Orocco system]] occurred in [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War's]] [[Orinda campaign]]. The [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant's]] [[181st Imperial Fighter Wing/Legends|181st Imperial Fighter Group]] and the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] were stalking each other throughout the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] and clashing in a series of strikes and parries. Orocco was one such engagement, and [[Turr Phennir/Legends|Turr Phennir's]] 181st and [[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu's]] Rogues battled to a draw.
